import { Component } from "@angular/core"; import { Router } from "@angular/router"; import { CartService } from "../../services/cart.service"; import { CartItem } from "../../models/cart-item"; @Component({ selector: "app-cart", templateUrl: "./cart.component.html", styleUrls: ["./cart.component.css"], }) export class CartComponent { constructor( public cart: CartService, private router: Router, ) {} get items(): CartItem[] { return this.cart.cartItems; } updateQty(productId: number, qty: number): void { this.cart.updateQuantity(productId, qty); } remove(productId: number): void { this.cart.removeFromCart(productId); } checkout(): void { this.router.navigate(["/checkout"]); } continueShopping(): void { this.router.navigate(["/products"]); } }
